name: KEMS
tagline: Your property data first. Full KEMS Agile when you need the detail.
summary: A mobile-ready read-only KEMS property companion with a robust panel-inspired live energy view, extended four-strategy comparison periods, Full KEMS Agile live/simulated telemetry, actual commissioned cost and ROI, and consolidated settings.
build: Web.28 panel-inspired live view with reliable HTML/CSS flows · Web.26 Today/Yesterday/7-day/30-day/Year/All-time comparison · Web.25 clean Live Data and Compare rebuild · responsive PWA shell
principles: Home Assistant and KEMS remain the source of truth for each property.
The user-facing product model is Live Data, Battery & Solar, Full KEMS and Full KEMS Agile.
The property Pi shows property data and settings; product marketing belongs on the public KEMS website.
Full KEMS Agile is the flagship strategy, but KEMS must report when another strategy wins on the available evidence.
Strategy comparison uses one common bill basis and one period selector, with missing evidence left unavailable rather than guessed.
The Live Data panel is inspired by the physical KEMS panel but uses robust web-native HTML/CSS rather than fragile artwork masks.
The panel keeps the same core functions: GRID/COST/IMPORT/EXPORT status, Solar/Grid/Home/Battery/EV layout, flow direction, battery SoC and EV state.
Long-period comparison never scales a shorter replay to invent Year or All-time evidence; unavailable strategies remain visibly unavailable.
Live Data reads the canonical /api/live metrics first rather than duplicating Home Assistant entity identifiers in the browser.
Live, simulated, shadow, forecast and reconstructed evidence are visibly labelled.
Cost & ROI uses commissioned live evidence only; simulated ROI stays on comparison/forecast surfaces.
The property website is read-only and cannot call Home Assistant services.
Pi update controls are local-network-only and use the appliance manager; they never call Home Assistant services.
Maintenance windows, automatic coordinated updates, automatic reboot permission and maintenance notices are configurable from local Settings.
Mobile uses the same responsive PWA property website so no app-store publication is required for the current phase.
The public kems.uk site receives no Home Assistant credentials, live control API or precise live household power.
Private property sign-in is delegated to Cloudflare Access and the KEMS App Launcher.
Raspberry Pi maintenance, updates, encrypted backups and Cloudflare connector provisioning remain local-only even when a property dashboard is reached through a remote gateway.
Cloudflare connector setup accepts only a tunnel token; pasted shell commands are never executed.
The private property tunnel targets KEMS Web on localhost:4173 only and never exposes Pi management, setup helpers, SSH, Home Assistant or the wider LAN.
Each property keeps its own Home Assistant credentials and KEMS data on its own appliance.
